title: Multicenter Validation on Predicting Mortality for Patients With Bleeding Peptic Ulcers
brief_summary: This study aimed to validate CU prediction model on mortality for patients with high risk bleeding peptic ulcers after therapeutic endoscopy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Patients presented with bleeding peptic ulcers
2. Age \> 18 year old
3. Informed consent for the study and OGD

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Unable or refuse to give consent
2. Onset more than 7 days
3. Pregnancy
study_population: Patients with bleeding peptic ulcers who required endoscopic therapy
